scope: one already registered smooth periodic shear real scalar time comparison; no new flow or PDE solve
state: unchanged original fixed-material-cell mass averages and original masses
coefficient_state_separation: seal all 12 exact geometry/coefficient caches before loading original mass/c0/reference packet
geometry: unchanged periodic_voronoi_fv.py; no jitter, fixed-k truncation, normalization or face clipping
primary: chronological expm_multiply of symmetric -M^-1/2 L M^-1/2; raw float shared-face sum diagonal, recorded trace; midpoint samples retained
independent: chronological full-sequence uniformization, independent exact local diagonal and offdiagonal conversion; never restart control from primary state
duration: exact T/K for each frozen interval; original saved float midpoint inputs unchanged
poisson_degree: smallest M>=0 with M+2>z and z^(M+1)/(M+1)!/(1-z/(M+2))<=budget; z=Lambda*dt, exp(-z)<=1 used conservatively; z=0 gives M=0
poisson_weights: exp(-float(z)), successive raw multiplication by float(z)/k; no weight/row/state renormalization or mean reset
solver_check: at every boundary primary/control mass-norm difference <= cumulative machine indicators plus cumulative omitted-tail mass-norm bounds
algebra_checks: raw mass drift, original initial extrema and nonincreasing original mass variance; no correction on failure
energy_check: shared-face raw chi at start/exponential midpoint/end, half variance decrease and Simpson check retained; no continuous dissipation claim
reference: only saved independent mass means and space/time difference vectors; retain initial bridge
reference_H_difference_base: saved time vector=M127-k128 minus best M127-k256; saved space vector=M63-k128 minus M127-k128; H indicators reconstruct these same pairs by raw addition only, never replace best reference
comparison_state_indicator: new4/8 difference + old4/8 difference +2*(reference space+time+initial bridge) +new4/8 cumulative solver indicators and observed differences + old saved exponential machine allowance
comparison_H_indicator: absolute new4/8 H difference + absolute old4/8 H difference +2*(reference H space/time and initial bridge indicators) +new primary/control H differences + energy-norm translation of cumulative solver indicators
decision: both nonzero checkpoints must show error gain exceeding the corresponding fixed comparison indicator; adverse or unresolved case stops without new K/N/D/threshold changes
